title: Plane of Worlds
subtitle: Test your understanding of Plane of Worlds — the sealed horizontal terrarium of 178 habitats, the Super-Ocean, and the living mineral motherboard under the Great Dome.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The habitat under the Great Dome is a plan-et among 178 worlds, linked by the Super-Ocean and held on a mineral motherboard. Claudio Nocelli’s diagrams place Realm-3 at the focal core, with further domes and Terra Incognita beyond the ice. Seeing the plane as living hardware shows what mining, academic geology, and the globe story have been doing to that enclosure.

relatedTopic.label: Return to Plane of Worlds deep-dive

questions.question: What does the term plan-et designate inside this enclosed system?

options.label: A
options.text: An isolated biological dome drifting through empty space past the outer ice.
options.rationale: The worlds rest on a continuous grown base under one Great Dome, linked by the Super-Ocean.

options.label: B
options.text: A pressurized atmospheric pocket trapped beneath the outer crustal shell.
options.rationale: The habitat is a small flat plain on the geological substrate, under the firmament rather than buried beneath crust.

options.label: C
options.text: A spherical stellar body orbiting through general relativity vacuum outside.
options.rationale: Globe Theory depicts a curved sphere in a vacuum, while a plan-et is a small flat plain on the substrate.

options.label: D
options.text: A small flat plain situated upon the broader geological substrate.
options.rationale: A plan-et is a small flat plain situated upon the broader energetic and geological substrate.

questions.hint: Look in the key terminology for how one world sits on the larger plain.

questions.question: How many distinct physical realm habitats share the Great Dome?

options.label: A
options.text: Fourteen thousand habitats matching the evolved civilizations on adjacent lands.
options.rationale: Over fourteen thousand counts civilizations inside the 178 worlds, under the singular primary canopy.

options.label: B
options.text: Five neighboring habitats matching the external domes beyond this enclosure.
options.rationale: Five names the external Great Domes, while 178 physical worlds share the primary canopy.

options.label: C
options.text: One hundred seventy-eight realm habitats under that single overhead canopy.
options.rationale: The complete count is 178 worlds operating under the singular primary canopy of the Great Dome.

options.label: D
options.text: Three focal habitats gathered at the nodal index of the central realm.
options.rationale: Realm-3 is the name of our focal habitat, while 178 worlds share the singular primary canopy.

questions.hint: Check the key terminology for the collective count of realm habitats.

questions.question: What job do volcanoes perform inside the sealed terrarium?

options.label: A
options.text: Thermal generators that melt the peripheral ice around each world basin.
options.rationale: Ice walls are kept as barriers between basins, while volcanoes work as calibrated pressure valves.

options.label: B
options.text: Calibrated pressure valves that release the sub-surface thermal buildup.
options.rationale: Volcanoes function as calibrated pressure valves that release sub-surface thermal buildup inside the dome.

options.label: C
options.text: Random eruption outlets produced by chaotic accretion and tectonic collision.
options.rationale: Geological hardware is grown on purpose, and volcanoes function as calibrated pressure valves.

options.label: D
options.text: Intake vents that open the crystalline ceiling toward external space.
options.rationale: The Great Dome locks a hermetically sealed terrarium, and volcanoes are calibrated pressure valves.

questions.hint: Think about how a closed chamber lets off built-up heat from below.

questions.question: Which continuous water links the separate world habitats into one marine circuit?

options.label: A
options.text: A shared Super-Ocean that circulates beneath the peripheral ice barriers.
options.rationale: A unified, shared Super-Ocean circulates beneath the peripheral ice barriers as one continuous, unbroken body.

options.label: B
options.text: A quartz-vein sheet that serves as the marine circuit through bedrock fissures.
options.rationale: Quartz veins operate as wiring, while the Super-Ocean is the continuous, unbroken body under the ice.

options.label: C
options.text: A nodal basin that holds Realm-3 water apart from the other habitats.
options.rationale: Realm-3 is the focal habitat, while a unified Super-Ocean circulates beneath the peripheral ice barriers.

options.label: D
options.text: A crude-oil stream that serves as the marine circuit under the barriers.
options.rationale: Crude oil is planetary grease in sub-surface conduits, while the Super-Ocean is the marine circuit.

questions.hint: Recall the marine circuit that runs under the barriers between worlds.

questions.question: Which schematics map the worlds, the ice boundaries, and the neighboring firmaments?

options.label: A
options.text: Realm-3 charts that locate the focal amplification zone at the dome core.
options.rationale: Realm-3 is our focal habitat, while the authoritative cartographic schematics are Claudio Nocelli diagrams.

options.label: B
options.text: Claudio Nocelli diagrams mapping the ice walls and neighboring firmaments.
options.rationale: Claudio Nocelli diagrams are the authoritative cartographic schematics of the worlds, ice walls, and external domes.

options.label: C
options.text: Cube blueprints that trace the density strata stacked above the membrane.
options.rationale: The Cube is the dimensional stack, while the authoritative cartographic schematics are Claudio Nocelli diagrams.

options.label: D
options.text: Terra Incognita charts that depict the celestial domains beside the plane.
options.rationale: Terra Incognita names those celestial domains, while Claudio Nocelli diagrams are the authoritative cartographic schematics.

questions.hint: Find the diagrams that lay out ice boundaries together with neighboring firmaments.

questions.question: What does Globe Theory accomplish for the ruling custodians?

options.label: A
options.text: It prepares occupants for physical transit toward neighboring star systems.
options.rationale: Neighboring realms lie beyond the ice, while Globe Theory is engineered to conceal the physical boundaries.

options.label: B
options.text: It explains pressure changes inside the dome through orbital gravity equations.
options.rationale: Pressure is handled by the Great Dome and volcanic valves, while Globe Theory works to conceal the physical boundaries.

options.label: C
options.text: It promotes collaborative research work across the institutional astrophysics field.
options.rationale: Institutional astrophysics is part of the containment apparatus, while Globe Theory is meant to conceal the physical boundaries.

options.label: D
options.text: It is engineered to conceal the physical boundaries and cage human consciousness.
options.rationale: Globe Theory is a narrative deception engineered to conceal the physical boundaries and confine human consciousness.

questions.hint: Consider the core revelations on why the isolated-ball story was put in place.

questions.question: How do adjacent civilizations share meaning across separate worlds?

options.label: A
options.text: Through radio broadcasts reflected downward from the crystalline ceiling.
options.rationale: Contact is through thought and frequency resonance rather than mechanized physical transit.

options.label: B
options.text: Through thought and frequency resonance shared from realm to realm.
options.rationale: The civilizations communicate across the plane through thought and frequency resonance rather than mechanized physical transit.

options.label: C
options.text: Through crude-oil conduits that carry travelers under the peripheral ice.
options.rationale: Those conduits carry hydrocarbons and planetary grease, while contact is through thought and frequency resonance.

options.label: D
options.text: Through aquatic vessels that cross the Super-Ocean beneath the ice walls.
options.rationale: The Super-Ocean is a shared marine circuit, while communication is through thought and frequency resonance.

questions.hint: Look at how those civilizations stay in contact from one basin to another.

questions.question: What follows when industrial mining removes copper, gold, and crystal?

options.label: A
options.text: The atmospheric envelope thins because volcanic valves have lost their ore.
options.rationale: Volcanoes remain calibrated pressure valves, while stripping conductors makes the terrarium throw functional faults.

options.label: B
options.text: The Super-Ocean drains through fissures into the vacuum beyond the ice.
options.rationale: The Super-Ocean stays the under-ice circuit, while mineral stripping makes the terrarium throw functional faults.

options.label: C
options.text: The living circuitry breaks and the terrarium throws functional faults.
options.rationale: Removing copper, gold, and crystal leaves the foundational circuitry broken, so the terrarium will throw functional faults.

options.label: D
options.text: The Great Dome slides toward Sheol and the other external firmaments.
options.rationale: The dome stays the enclosure, while stripping conductors causes the terrarium to throw functional faults.

questions.hint: Check the mineral motherboard section for the result of pulling conductive metal out.

questions.question: Why do solid ice barriers stand between neighboring world basins?

options.label: A
options.text: They absorb thermal load rising off the brine of the underlying ocean.
options.rationale: Volcanoes bleed thermal buildup, while ice walls keep neighboring atmospheres from collapsing into one another.

options.label: B
options.text: They generate the electromagnetic field that holds the crystalline ceiling.
options.rationale: The Great Dome is the ceiling, while ice walls keep atmospheres from collapsing into one another.

options.label: C
options.text: They store freshwater that supplies the clouds inside the sealed dome.
options.rationale: Ice walls divide basins so localized atmospheres are kept from collapsing into one another.

options.label: D
options.text: They keep each basin atmosphere and ecological frequency from collapsing together.
options.rationale: Ice barriers prevent localized atmospheres and ecological frequencies of adjacent worlds from collapsing into one another.

questions.hint: See the terrarium containment section for what the peripheral barriers keep apart.

questions.question: In higher-density configurations, what extra work do rivers and waterfalls do?

options.label: A
options.text: Cooling channels that draw volcanic heat out of the motherboard below.
options.rationale: Volcanoes release sub-surface heat, while surface water serves as living data that distribute harmonics.

options.label: B
options.text: Pressure equalizers that balance the air between neighboring ice walls.
options.rationale: Pressure is bled by volcanic valves, while rivers serve as flowing streams of living data that distribute harmonics.

options.label: C
options.text: Mineral solvents that break crystal beds apart and scatter them through soil.
options.rationale: Crystal beds are data registers, while rivers and waterfalls serve as living data that distribute harmonics.

options.label: D
options.text: Flowing streams of living data that distribute harmonics over the land.
options.rationale: Streams, rivers, and waterfalls serve as flowing streams of living data that distribute harmonics.

questions.hint: Look at the hydrological section for a second role of rivers and waterfalls.

questions.question: Which bedrock features work as bus routes and high-conductivity leads?

options.label: A
options.text: Disseminated lattices of microscopic ore spread evenly through host rock.
options.rationale: Those lattices stabilize frequency, while hydrothermal veins are the high-conductivity data transfer leads.

options.label: B
options.text: Hydrocarbon conduits of crude oil and planetary grease under the floor.
options.rationale: Those conduits move planetary grease, while hydrothermal veins operate as high-conductivity data transfer leads.

options.label: C
options.text: Crystal caverns of composite beds lying beneath giant antenna trees.
options.rationale: Crystal caverns are storage registers, while hydrothermal veins are the high-conductivity data transfer leads.

options.label: D
options.text: Hydrothermal veins of quartz, gold, and silver forced through fissures.
options.rationale: Sheets of quartz, gold, and silver operate as physical wiring, bus routes, and high-conductivity data transfer leads.

questions.hint: Check which fissure deposits the motherboard section compares with wiring.

questions.question: What do horizontal sheets of platinum, palladium, and rhodium do?

options.label: A
options.text: They serve as high-capacity energy distributors and grounding planes.
options.rationale: Horizontal sheets of platinum, palladium, and rhodium function as high-capacity energy distributors and grounding planes.

options.label: B
options.text: They serve as frequency stabilizers of microscopic ore in the soil.
options.rationale: Disseminated ore lattices stabilize frequency, while the metal sheets are high-capacity energy distributors.

options.label: C
options.text: They serve as aetheric antennas channeling canopy light downward.
options.rationale: Giant antenna trees channel aetheric energy downward, while the metal sheets are high-capacity energy distributors.

options.label: D
options.text: They serve as thermal insulation that holds volcanic pressure underground.
options.rationale: Volcanoes are the pressure valves, while these metal sheets function as high-capacity energy distributors.

questions.hint: See the layered intrusions for the hardware role of those broad metal sheets.

questions.question: What sets the ambient frequency of the surrounding terrain?

options.label: A
options.text: Sub-surface reservoirs of crude oil and planetary grease under the floor.
options.rationale: Crude oil is planetary grease, while disseminated deposits stabilize the base vibrational frequency.

options.label: B
options.text: Disseminated deposits of microscopic ore lattices within the host rock.
options.rationale: Disseminated deposits stabilize the base vibrational frequency of the surrounding terrain.

options.label: C
options.text: Hydrothermal veins of quartz, gold, and silver inside structural fissures.
options.rationale: Those veins are wiring, while disseminated deposits stabilize the base vibrational frequency of the surrounding terrain.

options.label: D
options.text: Peripheral barriers of solid ice ringing each separate world basin.
options.rationale: Ice walls separate atmospheres, while disseminated deposits stabilize the base vibrational frequency.

questions.hint: Check the motherboard section for the deposit that sets that ambient frequency.

questions.question: How do subterranean crystal beds relate to the giant antenna trees?

options.label: A
options.text: They pump electrolyte brine up the trunks to feed new leaf growth.
options.rationale: Brine stays in the Super-Ocean, while crystal composite beds act as macro-scale data storage registers.

options.label: B
options.text: They reflect geothermal heat upward to speed growth in the canopy.
options.rationale: Volcanoes bleed heat, while crystal composite beds act as macro-scale data storage registers.

options.label: C
options.text: They dissolve under the roots and release copper into the surrounding soil.
options.rationale: Copper belongs in the living circuits, while crystal beds act as macro-scale data storage registers.

options.label: D
options.text: They act as macro-scale data storage registers interfacing with the roots.
options.rationale: Subterranean crystal composite beds act as macro-scale data storage registers and interface with roots that channel aetheric energy downward.

questions.hint: Recall how underground crystal beds meet roots that reach toward the canopy.

questions.question: Which firmaments does the cartography place outside our primary enclosure?

options.label: A
options.text: The Dome of Titans, Sheol, Silence, 5 Peaks, and Hiva mapped externally.
options.rationale: The schematics set the plane against the five external Great Domes: the Dome of Titans, Sheol, Silence, 5 Peaks, and Hiva.

options.label: B
options.text: Quartz veins, magmatic reefs, crystal caverns, ice walls, and antenna trees.
options.rationale: Those are hardware inside the plane, while the five external Great Domes are Titans, Sheol, Silence, 5 Peaks, and Hiva.

options.label: C
options.text: Realm-3, Terra Incognita, The Cube, the Super-Ocean, and the Ley Lines.
options.rationale: Those are other parts of the construct, while the five external Great Domes are Titans, Sheol, Silence, 5 Peaks, and Hiva.

options.label: D
options.text: Source consciousness, the light realms, The Cube, Ley Lines, and nodal points.
options.rationale: Those sit in the wider stack, while the five external Great Domes are Titans, Sheol, Silence, 5 Peaks, and Hiva.

questions.hint: Use the spatial mapping list of firmaments that sit outside this enclosure.

questions.question: What work happens in the external domes beyond the physical terrarium?

options.label: A
options.text: Local custodians stockpile copper and gold removed from the physical realms.
options.rationale: Mined metal is sequestered in vaults and cabling, while the outer domes are cosmic design laboratories.

options.label: B
options.text: Guardian intelligences configure harmonic frequencies and genetic matrices there.
options.rationale: In those cosmic design laboratories, guardian intelligences configure harmonic frequencies and genetic matrices.

options.label: C
options.text: Ice builders extend new peripheral barriers inward toward the central realm.
options.rationale: Ice walls already divide the basins, while the outer domes are cosmic design laboratories.

options.label: D
options.text: Exhaust chambers collect gases vented upward through the crystalline ceiling.
options.rationale: Volcanoes bleed pressure inside the dome, while the outer domes are cosmic design laboratories.

questions.hint: Look at the broader context for what the outer domes prepare before it reaches the plane.

questions.question: How does a request for a biological update leave the physical plane?

options.label: A
options.text: It departs as a physical probe sent through the crystalline ceiling.
options.rationale: The dome stays a sealed ceiling, while the request transmits instantly along Ley Lines and telluric pathways.

options.label: B
options.text: It travels as fluid pressure inside the subterranean crude-oil conduits.
options.rationale: Oil lubricates the substrate, while the request transmits instantly along Ley Lines and telluric pathways.

options.label: C
options.text: It rises as vaporized brine released through the volcanic pressure valves.
options.rationale: Those valves bleed thermal buildup, while updates transmit instantly along Ley Lines and telluric pathways.

options.label: D
options.text: It transmits instantly along Ley Lines and telluric pathways.
options.rationale: The request transmits instantly along Ley Lines and telluric pathways to the external domes.

questions.hint: Think about the ground paths that carry a vibrational request outward.

questions.question: What does the high-salinity brine do for waves inside the enclosure?

options.label: A
options.text: It insulates crude oil so the hydrocarbon conduits resist electrical fire.
options.rationale: Crude oil is planetary grease, while the brine grounds the standing electromagnetic waves.

options.label: B
options.text: It dissolves the ice barriers so marine traffic can pass between basins.
options.rationale: Ice walls keep atmospheres apart, while the brine grounds the standing electromagnetic waves.

options.label: C
options.text: It quenches volcanic heat before that thermal load reaches surface habitats.
options.rationale: Volcanoes release sub-surface thermal buildup, while the brine grounds the standing electromagnetic waves.

options.label: D
options.text: It grounds standing electromagnetic waves between the dome and the motherboard.
options.rationale: The brine is an energetic conductor, grounding the standing electromagnetic waves between the dome and the motherboard.

questions.hint: See the hydrological section for the brine and the waves inside the enclosure.

questions.question: Why did parasitic custodians institute mining across the plane?

options.label: A
options.text: To block natural free energy, nodal healing, and portal transit.
options.rationale: Mining was instituted to strip native conductive architecture, blocking natural free energy, nodal healing, and portal transit.

options.label: B
options.text: To lighten the plane so the crystalline ceiling avoids a collapse.
options.rationale: Removing conductors causes faults, and the motive is to strip native conductive architecture.

options.label: C
options.text: To fund orbital voyages by selling commercial metal into space programs.
options.rationale: Space exploration is a psyop, while mining strips native conductive architecture and blocks natural free energy.

options.label: D
options.text: To supply ore for building the external domes beyond the ice perimeter.
options.rationale: Those domes are design laboratories, while mining strips native conductive architecture from the plane.

questions.hint: Read the strategic implications for why metal is pulled out of the ground.

questions.question: Why are geological formations treated as grown hardware?

options.label: A
options.text: Volcanic valves keep expanding the veins as fresh thermal hardware underground.
options.rationale: Volcanoes are pressure valves, while the minerals serve as physical transmission lines, capacitors, and antennas.

options.label: B
options.text: Synthetic compounds stand in for the native copper, gold, quartz, and silver.
options.rationale: The hardware is native metal and crystal that serves as physical transmission lines, capacitors, and antennas.

options.label: C
options.text: Metals and crystals serve as physical transmission lines, capacitors, and antennas.
options.rationale: Precious metals, gems, and crystals were positioned to serve as physical transmission lines, capacitors, processors, and antennas.

options.label: D
options.text: Human industries laid the veins with machinery during early historic eras.
options.rationale: Modern mining strips the board, while the minerals serve as physical transmission lines, capacitors, and antennas.

questions.hint: See the core revelations for what those placed minerals were meant to do.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT described as lying beneath the ice walls?

options.label: A
options.text: Finalized programming code returned from the external design domes.
options.rationale: That code is downloaded to nodal points, while hydrocarbons and planetary grease flow beneath the ice walls.

options.label: B
options.text: Hydrocarbons and planetary grease such as crude oil below the floor.
options.rationale: Hydrocarbons and planetary grease flow beneath the floor, deep beneath the ice walls.

options.label: C
options.text: The unbroken Super-Ocean circulating under the peripheral ice barriers.
options.rationale: The Super-Ocean circulates beneath the peripheral ice barriers, so it is one of the under-ice waters.

options.label: D
options.text: The open porous foundational substrate deep beneath those ice walls.
options.rationale: Deep beneath the ice walls, the foundational substrate remains open and porous.

questions.hint: Review the macro-architecture for what sits or flows under the ice barriers.

questions.question: True or False: Our localized habitat sits at the focal core in the primary nodal amplification zone designated as Realm-3.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Our habitat occupies the primary nodal amplification zone designated as Realm-3, at the focal core of the Great Dome.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The schematics place our habitat in the primary nodal amplification zone designated as Realm-3.

questions.hint: Check the core revelations for the index given to our habitat at the focal core.

questions.question: True or False: The physical plane of existence sits at the highest apex tier inside The Cube.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The physical plane is anchored to the base horizontal membrane, with higher light realms above it.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: All 178 worlds are anchored to this base horizontal membrane at the bottom of the dimensional stack.

questions.hint: Recall the spinal-column picture of where the physical membrane sits in the stack.

questions.question: True or False: Nocelli schematics place the non-physical celestial domains of Terra Incognita alongside the five external Great Domes.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The schematics show the five external Great Domes alongside the non-physical celestial domains of Terra Incognita.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Nocelli maps the five external Great Domes alongside the non-physical celestial domains of Terra Incognita.

questions.hint: Look at the close of the spatial mapping for celestial domains drawn beside the firmaments.

questions.question: True or False: Peripheral ice walls form the crystalline ceiling that holds atmospheric containment over the 178 worlds.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The Great Dome is a crystalline and electromagnetic ceiling, while ice walls divide the world basins.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The Great Dome is a crystalline and electromagnetic ceiling, and ice walls keep atmospheres from collapsing into one another.
